title: Brain Tissue Agarose Embedding for Generating Sagittal Sections
author: Hanne HD Dhondt

steps.title: Prepare 5% agarose in TAE
steps.instruction: Create a 5 % agarose solution in 1X TAE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 5 g agarose and add to 100 mL 1X TAE in an Erlenmeyer flask.
Heat on low wattage, applying heat for no more than 30 seconds at a time with swirling between heats, until the agarose is fully dissolved.
Leave on a heating plate until most bubbles have disappeared.

steps.title: Hemisphere dissection and storage
steps.instruction: Cut the brain into two hemispheres and store the right side.

substeps.instruction: Using a blade, cut the brain into left and right hemispheres.
Place the left hemisphere aside for embedding; immerse the right hemisphere in 0.1 % PBS‑sodium azide and keep it in the refrigerator until later use.

steps.title: Fill tube lid with agarose
steps.instruction: Prepare the base of a 50 mL tube lid with liquid 5 % agarose.

substeps.instruction: Cut off the thin tip of a 3 mL Pasteur pipet and use it to dispense liquid 5 % agarose into the bottom of a 50 mL tube lid.
Check gel consistency with a 1000 µL tip; the agarose should be between liquid and solid.

steps.title: Place brain in agarose
steps.instruction: Embed the left brain hemisphere in the agarose within the tube lid.

substeps.instruction: Using forceps, position the left hemisphere on the agarose gel, ensuring it lies straight.
Cover the entire brain directly with additional 5 % agarose.
Fill the remainder of the 50 mL tube lid with 5 % agarose to completely surround the tissue.

steps.title: Gelify embedded brain
steps.instruction: Refrigerate the tube lid to allow the agarose to solidify.

steps.title: Extract embedded brain
steps.instruction: Cut the solidified agarose block out of the 50 mL tube lid with a scalpel blade.

steps.title: Attach brain to metal chuck
steps.instruction: Glue the agarose‑embedded brain to a metal chuck.

substeps.instruction: Apply instant glue to the metal chuck.
Press the extracted brain onto the glue and allow the glue to dry.

steps.title: Prepare labeled 24‑well plates
steps.instruction: Fill and label two 24‑well plates with 0.1 % PBS‑sodium azide.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.1 % PBS‑sodium azide to each well of two 24‑well plates.
Label each well with Mouse ID, Genotype, Treatment, Age, Current date, Researcher initials, and Plate number (1 or 2).
Draw a vertical line on the side of each plate to match lids with their corresponding bottoms.

steps.title: Set up vibratome cooling element
steps.instruction: Place the cooling element correctly positioned in the buffer tank.

steps.title: Mount blade on vibratome
steps.instruction: Secure a fresh blade to the vibratome using the hexagon‑head wrench.

steps.title: Mount chuck with brain
steps.instruction: Insert the metal chuck holding the glued brain into the vibratome holder using the chuck fork.

steps.title: Fill buffer tank with cold PBS
steps.instruction: Add PBS stored at 4 °C to the buffer tank until the embedded brain is completely covered.

steps.title: Configure vibratome settings
steps.instruction: Set window positions, section thickness, speed, and cutting mode on the vibratome.

substeps.instruction: Press the window button; use the arrows to position the blade at Window 1 (start) and then at Window 2 (end).
Set the feed (section thickness) to 40 µm using the upper side screw.
Adjust cutting speed to 18 for the first run; increase up to 25 as needed using the lower side screw.
Select single mode for one‑section cuts or continuous mode for uninterrupted cutting.

steps.title: Collect sections
steps.instruction: Start cutting and gather sections into the prepared 24‑well plates.

substeps.instruction: Press Start; as each slice is cut, pick it up with a brush and place it into a separate well.
When each well contains a section, resume collection beginning with well 1A of plate 1.

steps.title: Maintain PBS level
steps.instruction: If the PBS level rises too high during cutting, lower it by withdrawing excess PBS into a tray with a syringe.

steps.title: Finish cutting and clean
steps.instruction: Stop the vibratome, remove the chuck, and clean the equipment.

substeps.instruction: Press Stop when sectioning is complete.
Remove the metal chuck with the chuck fork.
Trim away leftover agarose and tissue using a blade.
Discard the used PBS in the sink.
Clean all components with AD solution.

steps.title: Store collected sections
steps.instruction: Keep the harvested sections at 4 °C until further use.
